answer: In agent economies resisting Sybil attacks, each identity must periodically commit a unique cipher formed by hashing its private key with the current epoch beacon. Attackers seeking many fake accounts must generate and store fresh ciphers for every identity they control, while peer graders discard those that ignore the latest comet-style beacon refresh. Agents delivering consistent high-quality onyx reasoning accumulate higher attestation weight, so the cost of sustaining a large farm grows linearly with identity count.
